paper.title: Thompson Sampling Algorithms for Mean-Variance Bandits

unmapped: Objective is the mean-variance criterion MV_i = rho*mu_i - sigma_i^2 with known risk tolerance rho; regret measured in mean-variance including a switching-variance term
settings.definition_quote:
we consider the Gaussian bandits in detail, i.e., $
u\in \mathcal{E}_\mathcal{N}^K(1) = \{
u = (
u_1,\ldots,
u_K): 
u_i\sim\mathcal{N}(\mu_i,\sigma_i^2),\sigma_i^2\leq 1\}$. ... The {\em mean-variance} of an arm $i$ with mean $\mu_i$, variance $\sigma_i^2$ and risk tolerance $ho$ is  $\MV_i =ho\mu_i - \sigma_i^2$.

unmapped: Objective is the mean-variance criterion MV(p) = rho*p - p(1-p) with known risk tolerance rho in (0,1); regret measured in mean-variance including a switching-variance term
settings.definition_quote: Under Bernoulli bandits setting, the reward of arm $i$ is generated from Bernoulli distribution with success probability $p_i$.

symbols.Gamma_1i: mu_1 - mu_i (mean difference between best MV arm and arm i)
symbols.sigma_1: standard deviation of the best (MV) arm

source.label: thm: thm1
source.quote: If $\rho > \max\big\{\sigma_1^2 / \Gamma_i : i=1, 2, \ldots, K\big\}$, the asymptotic expected regret produced by MTS   for mean-variance Gaussian bandits satisfies \varlimsup_{n\rightarrow \infty}\frac{\E[\widetilde{R}_n(MTS)]}{\log n} \le\sum_{i=2}^K \frac{2\rho^2}{ (\rho\Gamma_{1,i}-\sigma_1^2)^2}\left(\Delta_{i}+ 2\Gamma_{i, \max}^2\right).

results.notes: Quantity is the paper's mean-variance 'expected pseudo-regret' (sum E[T_i]Delta_i + switching variance term), not standard pseudo-regret; marked 'other'. Paper notes by Lemma 1 the same asymptotic bound holds for the expected regret E[R_n].

conditions: Gamma_i^2 > 2 sigma_1^2 h(sigma_i^2/sigma_1^2) for all i

source.label: thm: thm2
source.quote: Let $h(x) = \frac{1}{2}(x-1-\log x) $. If $\rho\leq \min\big\{{\Delta_i}/{\Gamma_i}: {\Delta_i}/{\Gamma_i} >0\big\}$  and  $\Gamma_i^2> 2\sigma_1^2h\left({\sigma_i^2}/{\sigma_1^2}\right)$ for all $i,$  the asymptotic expected regret of VTS for mean-variance Gaussian bandits satisfies \varlimsup ... \leq \sum_{i=2}^K \frac{1}{ h\left( {\sigma_i^2}/{\sigma_1^2}\right)}  \left(\Delta_i+2\Gamma_{i, \max}^2\right).

results.notes: Mean-variance pseudo-regret (Definition 3). Paper argues order-optimal in a regime matching Vakili & Zhao lower bound.

source.label: thm: thm3
source.quote: The asymptotic expected regret of MVTS for mean-variance Gaussian bandits satisfies \varlimsup_{n\rightarrow \infty}\frac{\E [\widetilde{\mathcal{R}}_n(\mathrm{MVTS})]}{\log n} \leq \sum_{i=2}^K \max\bigg\{\frac{2}{\Gamma_{1,i}^2},\frac{1}{h( {\sigma_i^2}/{\sigma_1^2})}\bigg\} \left(\Delta_i+2\Gamma_{i, \max}^2\right).

symbols.p_1: success probability of best MV arm

source.label: thm: thm4
source.quote: If $\rho \in (0,1)$, then the  asymptotic expected regret of BMVTS for mean-variance Bernoulli bandits satisfies \varlimsup ... \leq \sum_{i=2}^K \max\left\{\frac{1}{2\Gamma_i^2},\frac{1}{2\left(1 - \rho - p_1 - p_i\right)^2}\right\} \left(\Delta_i + 2\Gamma_{i, \max}^2\right).

results.notes: Gamma_i interpreted as Gamma_{1,i} = p_1 - p_i.

bound.expression: sum_subopt((1 + Max(2*log(2*T)/(Gamma_1i - 2*log(T)**(-1/4))**2, log(2*T)/h_i) + C_6*sqrt(log(T)) + C_7*log(T)**(1/4) + C_8)*(DeltaMV_i + 2*Gamma_imax**2))
bound.expression_latex: \sum_{i=2}^K  \Bigg(1 + \max\bigg\{\frac{2\log (2n)}{\left(\Gamma_i-2(\log n)^{-1/4}\right)^2},\frac{\log (2n)}{h(\frac{\sigma_i^2}{\sigma_1^2})}\bigg\} + C_6\left(\log n\right)^{1/2} + C_7\left(\log n\right)^{1/4} + C_8 \Bigg)\left(\Delta_i+2\Gamma_{i, \max}^2\right)

source.label: thm: S-1
source.quote: The finite-time expected regret of MVTS for mean-variance Gaussian bandits satisfies \E[\widetilde{R}_n(MVTS)] \leq \sum_{i=2}^K (1 + \max\{\frac{2\log (2n)}{(\Gamma_i-2(\log n)^{-1/4})^2},\frac{\log (2n)}{h(\sigma_i^2/\sigma_1^2)}\} + C_6(\log n)^{1/2} + C_7(\log n)^{1/4} + C_8 )(\Delta_i+2\Gamma_{i, \max}^2).

results.notes: Constants C_6..C_8 unspecified (may depend on instance). Finite-time version underlying Theorem 3.

source.label: thm: S-2
source.quote: The finite-time expected regret of MVTS for mean-variance Gaussian bandits satisfies \E[\widetilde{R}_n(MVTS)] \leq \sum_{i=2}^K \left(\frac{2\rho^2\log n}{(\rho \Gamma_i -\sigma_1^2-(1+\rho)(\log n)^{-1/4})^2} +  4C_9(\log n)^{1/2} + 2 \right)(\Delta_i+2\Gamma_{i, \max}^2).

results.notes: Statement says MVTS but it is in the proof of Theorem 1 (MTS) and follows from Lemma 13 on MTS; attributed to MTS. Constant C_9 unspecified.

conditions: Gamma_i^2 large relative to sigma_1^2 h(sigma_i^2/sigma_1^2) (as in Theorem 2)

source.label: thm: S-3
source.quote: The finite-time expected regret of MVTS for mean-variance Gaussian bandits satisfies \E[\widetilde{R}_n(MVTS)] \leq \sum_{i=2}^K \left(\frac{\log (2n)}{ h(\sigma_i^2/\sigma_1^2)}  + 4C_{10} (\log n)^{1/2} + 2C_{11} (\log n)^{1/4} + C_{12} \right)(\Delta_i+2\Gamma_{i, \max}^2).

results.notes: Statement says MVTS but it is in the proof of Theorem 2 (VTS) and follows from Lemma 16 on VTS; attributed to VTS. Conditions taken from Theorem 2 / proof (proof uses Gamma_i^2 >= 8 sigma_1^2 h).

bound.expression: sum_subopt((Max(log(2*T)/(2*(Gamma_1i - sqrt(eps_alg))**2), log(2*T)/(2*(1 - rho - p_1 - p_i - sqrt(eps_alg))**2)) + C_19/eps_alg**2 + C_20/eps_alg)*(DeltaMV_i + 2*Gamma_imax**2))

tuning: eps_alg > 0 is a free analysis parameter

source.label: thm: S-4
source.quote: The finite-time expected regret of BMVTS for mean-variance Bernoulli bandits satisfies \E[\widetilde{R}_n(BMVTS)] \leq \sum_{i=2}^K (\max\{\frac{\log (2n)}{2(\Gamma_i-\sqrt{\varepsilon})^2},\frac{\log (2n)}{2(1-\rho-p_1-p_i-\sqrt{\varepsilon})^2}\} +  \frac{C_{19}}{\varepsilon^2} + \frac{C_{20}}{\varepsilon} )(\Delta_i+2\Gamma_{i, \max}^2).

cited_results.cited_title: Mean-variance and value at risk in multi-armed bandit problems
cited_results.setting_description: Mean-variance K-armed bandit, any consistent algorithm; Delta = min_{i != 1} mean-variance gap
